rationale: The failed-opening distribution thesis remains mechanically intact — price is still below VWAP ($33.74) and the 9-EMA ($33.51) on 6.6x relative volume with a mildly risk-off tape, and the bounce off 33.30 is drifting up on clearly declining volume (under 7k/min vs the 74k breakdown bar). The invalidation at 33.57 has not been hit, and risk/reward from here is still favorable (~9 cents to the stop vs ~32 cents to the 33.16 gap-fill target, roughly 3.5:1). A flip long would require a volume-backed reclaim of the 9-EMA/VWAP that has not occurred, and closing now would abandon a live setup with the stop still defining risk.
